text.en: Most reviewers over the past year describe the vets and clinic team in Mount Florida as friendly, understanding, and genuinely dedicated to animal welfare. However, one pet owner shared a strongly critical account alleging rude, unempathetic behaviour from veterinary and reception staff and dissatisfaction with how a formal complaint was handled.

Several dog and cat owners praise the practice for taking great care of their pets and putting their wellbeing first during visits. In contrast, one reviewer reported a deeply distressing experience involving a small pet, alleging that rough handling during the consultation caused severe fear and led to the animal passing away.

While cat owners mention straightforward routine neutering procedures, two dog owners expressed serious dissatisfaction with clinical outcomes. One reviewer felt repeated tablet prescriptions failed to resolve a persistent chest and cough issue, and another alleged that early symptoms of a fatal illness were overlooked by the practice.

q.en: Does The Avenues Veterinary Centre in Mount Florida perform routine neutering?

a.en: Yes, the clinic performs surgical neutering for cats and dogs alongside general veterinary procedures.

q.en: How do clients describe the veterinary fees and treatment costs?

a.en: One reviewer criticised the cost of repeated medication courses and follow-up consultations when treating an ongoing cough.

q.en: Is car parking available near the Cathcart Road surgery?

a.en: Yes, public car parking spaces are available in close proximity to the Mount Florida practice.

q.en: Who covers out-of-hours emergencies for the clinic?

a.en: Out-of-hours emergency care is provided through Emergency Vets Glasgow.
